one_liner: Customer operations and helpdesk platform that brings teams and AI agents together across email, chat, and other channels.
access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account or trial to generate API tokens or set up OAuth.
verdict_reason: Front provides documented REST APIs with self-serve token generation and OAuth support, plus an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
There are two ways to get a Bearer token — through API tokens in your settings or through an OAuth implementation.
You can create a developer account by signing up here. You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need
